name: FIDE
body: DMARC rejects spoofed mail, the sitemap answers with valid URLs, and the text reads without JavaScript. But the plain-http home page answers 200 instead of redirecting, and no HSTS header is sent.
lesson: Redirect every http request to https with a 301, then add Strict-Transport-Security.
summary: www.fide.com scores 64 out of 100 (D). 4 checks fail now, 27 are at risk, and 14 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 19 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: Plain http serves the site without redirecting
fix.evidence: http:// answered 200. Visitors who type the address stay unencrypted.
fix.fix: Redirect every http request to https with a 301, then add HSTS.

fix.title: 3 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /category/fide-news/, /category/chess-news/, /documents/. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 160 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 19 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: 19 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /, /news/, /fide-world-championship-cycle-2025-2026/, /about-fide/ and 15 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Cookies are Secure, and session cookies are HttpOnly
The start page declares its language
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
